_metadata.description: Typed jobs validated against the scope-catalog-derived scenario-CLI manifest and registry-owned execution scopes; never raw shell. The typed scenario screenshot verb remains Mode A, uses the operator-configured vrooli binary, and returns a bounded authenticated run artifact when the target has a usable display session.

requirements.title: Allowlisted Typed-Job Dispatch
requirements.description: The control plane dispatches typed jobs — {scenario, verb, args} validated against a manifest derived from scenario CLI governance — never raw shell strings. The node registry owns the execution scopes that intersect the derived manifest; a node with no execution scopes is presence-only. Typed output declarations are also manifest-controlled: the node writes only to a private generated path, uploads bounded bytes over authenticated node RPC, and the owner retrieves them through the owner-gated artifacts RPC. `vrooli-bridge:session` is reserved for a future interactive protocol and is not implemented here.

validation.notes: A job whose verb is absent from the manifest or outside the node's scopes is rejected before reaching the node.

The node-agent executes only typed verbs via the local vrooli CLI; it never constructs or runs an arbitrary shell string. Declared outputs are uploaded only after bounded file reads through the authenticated artifact seam.
Attempting a non-allowlisted verb on a node is denied and audited; an allowlisted verb succeeds.
